items.title: 20.2.2 Steps of Recombinant DNA Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the steps of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 157-160).

blocks.text: i: DNA Cleavage (DNA ko kaatna): Jis jandar se gene lena hai us ka source DNA restriction endonuclease se kaata jata hai aur gene of interest alag kar liya jata hai. Isi tarah vector ka DNA (maslan plasmid ya virus ka DNA) bhi usi endonuclease se kaata jata hai. Is tarah gene of interest aur kate hue vector dono par aapas mein milne wale (compatible) sticky ends ban jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam. Qadam 1: janwar ke cell ka DNA (gene of interest ke ird gird recognition sites) aur E. coli ka plasmid (recognition site wala lacZ' gene, antibiotic muzahimat ka gene) aik hi enzyme se kaate jate hain aur sticky ends bante hain. Qadam 2: DNA ligase inhein jor kar recombinant DNA plasmids banata hai jin ka lacZ' gene be-kaar (nonfunctional) hai. Qadam 3: plasmids bacterial cells mein jate hain jo Clone 1, 2 aur 3 banate hain. Qadam 4: clones mein gene of interest dhoonda jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.3: Recombinant vectors banane ke qadam (kitab ki Figure 20.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Animal cell, DNA, Gene of interest, E. coli, Plasmid, lacZ' gene, Recognition site, Antibiotic resistance gene, Sticky ends, Recombinant DNA, Nonfunctional lacZ' gene, Clone 1-3, aur chaar qadam ki ibaratein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 20.3 mein plasmid ke gene ko 'Antibody resistance gene' likha hai. Sahi naam 'antibiotic resistance gene' (antibiotic ke khilaf muzahimat ka gene) hai, jaisa kitab ke apne matan (text) mein bhi hai; is liye upar ke khaake mein sahi naam likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step 1: janwar ke cell ka DNA aur E. coli ka plasmid aik hi restriction endonuclease se kaate jate hain aur sticky ends bante hain. Step 2: DNA ligase in ko jor kar recombinant DNA banata hai; gene of interest lacZ' gene ke beech mein lagne se lacZ' gene nonfunctional (bekaar) ho jata hai. Step 3: recombinant DNA bacteria mein jata hai jo barh kar clones banate hain. Step 4: clones mein gene of interest talaash kiya jata hai. Antibiotic resistance gene ki wajah se sirf plasmid wale bacteria antibiotic wali plate par ugte hain.

ii: Recombinant DNA (vector) ki tayyari: Gene of interest ko kate hue vector mein dala jata hai. Is ke liye kata hua vector aur gene of interest DNA ligase ki maujoodgi mein aik saath incubate kiye jate hain (munasib halaat mein rakhe jate hain). Yeh enzyme phosphodiester linkages bana kar dono ko jor deta hai. Is tarah vector recombinant vector ban jata hai, yaani aisa vector jis mein gene of interest hai.

Recombinant DNA (vector) aur expression system (aam taur par bacteria) aik hi medium mein incubate kiye jate hain. Bacterial cells recombinant DNA ko andar le lete hain. Phir yeh sab bacteria taqseem ho kar bacterial clones (aik jaise bacteria ke groups) banate hain, jin mein gene of interest ki bilkul aik jaisi copies, yaani clones, bhi hoti hain.
Jab vectors host cells mein dal diye jate hain to scientists yeh pehchante hain ke kin bacteria ne waqai recombinant plasmid liya hai. Yeh kaam in tareeqon se hota hai:

i: Vector wale bacteria chunna (antibiotic resistance): Plasmid mein aik antibiotic resistance gene hota hai. Bacteria ko aise medium par ugaya jata hai jis mein woh antibiotic (maslan ampicillin) ho. Sirf woh cells zinda reh kar barhte hain jinhon ne plasmid liya ho.

ii: Gene of interest wale bacteria chunna (Blue-White Screening): "Saada" (plain) plasmid aur "recombinant plasmid" mein farq karne ke liye plasmid ka lacZ' gene istemal hota hai. lacZ' gene aisa enzyme banata hai jo aik khaas sugar ko metabolize karta hai (todta hai) aur use neela (blue) kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Bacterial cells ki chaar qismein: kaam karne wale lacZ' gene ka plasmid; plasmid nahi; gene of interest wala plasmid; DNA tukre wala plasmid (be-kaar lacZ' gene). 'Eliminate cells without plasmid' teer antibiotic wali plate tak jata hai jahan sirf plasmid wale cells clones banate hain. 'Eliminate cells without rDNA' teer cheeni (sugar) wali plate tak jata hai: neele clones rDNA ke baghair aur safaid clones rDNA ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.4: Clones ki chhaan been (bina vector (plasmid) wale clones aur vector (plasmid) wale magar recombinant DNA ke baghair clones ka khatma) (kitab ki Figure 20.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels kitab ke mutabiq: Antibiotic in media, Sugar in media, Clones with rDNA (safaid), Clones without rDNA (neele), Eliminate cells without plasmid, Eliminate cells without rDNA.

blocks.text: Agar plasmid recombinant nahin to lacZ' gene kaam karta rehta hai aur bacterial colony neeli ho jati hai. Agar gene of interest kamyabi se lacZ' gene ke andar lag gaya to woh lacZ' gene ko "tor" deta hai. Is liye matloob (desired) recombinant clones safaid (white) rehte hain.

iii: Khaas gene ki pehchan (DNA Hybridization): Gene of interest ki maujoodgi pakki karne ke liye radioactive probe istemal hota hai. Probe DNA ka aik strand hai jo gene of interest ka complementary hai. Probe sirf unhi colonies se chipakta (hybridize hota) hai jin mein gene of interest ho. Phir auto-radiography (photographic film) se master plate par in khaas colonies ki jagah maloom ki jati hai. Is tareeqe ke bare qadam neeche diye gaye diagram mein hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khaakon ke gird paanch numbered qadam. 1: plasmid wale bacteria ke clones agar plate par. 2: clones par filter daba kar naqal (replica). 3: filter ko DNA kholne wale mehlool se dhoya jata hai jis mein radioactive probe hai. 4: filter par rakhi film par sirf wahan nishan aata hai jahan clone ne probe pakra. 5: nishan se asal plate tak teer gene of interest wala clone pehchanta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.5: Gene of interest wale clones ki pehchaan (kitab ki Figure 20.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Filter, Film, aur paanch qadmon ki kitabi ibaratein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 1: plasmid wale bacteria ke clones agar plate par ugaye jate hain. 2: clones par filter daba kar plate ki naqal (replica) banti hai. 3: filter ko aise mehlool (solution) se dhoya jata hai jo DNA ke strands alag karta hai aur jis mein radioactive probe hai. 4: film par sirf un clones ka nishan aata hai jinhon ne probe pakra. 5: film ko asal plate se mila kar gene of interest wala clone pehchana jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ampicillin aur khaas sugar wali plate par kaun si colonies chunenge, neeli ya safaid? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Safaid. Jo colony bhi ugi hai us mein plasmid hai (ampicillin resistance ki wajah se), lekin sirf safaid colony mein dale gaye gene ne lacZ' gene ko tora hai, yaani us ka plasmid recombinant hai.

items: Gene aur vector aik hi restriction endonuclease se kaate jate hain; DNA ligase dono ko jor kar recombinant vector banata hai.
Bacteria recombinant DNA le kar clones banate hain jin mein gene ki aik jaisi copies hoti hain.

Screening: antibiotic plasmid ke baghair cells khatam karta hai; blue-white screening mein recombinant colonies safaid rehti hain; radioactive probe aur auto-radiography gene wali colony pakki karte hain.
